verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a general user-defined rules or event-trigger system, such as alerts, triggers, or webhooks that fire actions. Autobilling is a single fixed billing switch, and serverless benchmark-driven scaling is platform-managed. Both are adjacent features, and the CLI, REST API and agent skill are only building blocks a user would script around.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
